name: Quorum Of Three
hint: Four takes. The door at x=30 needs p1 AND p2 AND p3 held at the same instant, and the plates sit 8 units apart (p1 x=5..7, p2 x=13..15, p3 x=21..23) so one 0.8-wide body can never bridge two of them. TAKE 1: run right onto p1, stand, end the take. TAKE 2: Echo A holds p1; run past it onto p2, stand, end the take. TAKE 3: Echoes A and B hold p1 and p2; run onto p3, stand, end the take. All three are held during this take but you are pinned on p3 and the doorway is 7 units further on, so you cannot cash it in yourself. TAKE 4: Echo C reaches p3 at about t=2.1s, which is when the door starts opening; you run straight from spawn and arrive at the doorway at about t=3.0s, so it is already clear. Continue to the exit at x=36. The door is 6 units tall with a bulkhead above it running to the top of the world, so there is no route over.

dialogue.text: Three plates. The room was built for a crew.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: There was a crew. You are what is left of it, taken one at a time.
Stand still three times. Then walk out past all of them.
